question:
Mohit, Punnet, Bobby, Anshul, Naveen and Rohit are living in the six floors of a six storeyed apartment numbered 1 to 6. Floor 1 is lowest and floor 6 is the is the highest. Bobby is living in a even-numbered floor. Naveen is not living either at the topmost floor or the bottom most floor. Mohit is above punnet and bobby. Rohit is below anshul. There are two floor between naveen and punnet and they both does not live on the lowest floor.

Where is Rohit living with respect to Bobby?
